categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates as a 6-inch semiconductor wafer foundry focusing on power semiconductor devices, especially for automotive and industrial applications. Key product lines include Power MOSFETs, Diodes (including Schottky and Low Loss Diodes), TVS (Transient Voltage Suppressors), FRED (Fast Recovery Epitaxial Diodes), IGBTs, and SiC (Silicon Carbide) semiconductor devices. The company also develops customized analog ICs and is expanding into compound semiconductor technologies such as GaN HEMT.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes trench technology for Power MOSFETs and IGBTs, including Shielded Gate and Field Stop structures. It has developed high-voltage and high-current power devices, with advanced processes for automotive-grade components. The firm is building SiC semiconductor process capabilities and production lines, aiming for trial production and monthly capacity of 3,000 wafers. It also focuses on product reliability, quality control, and ESG-compliant manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include international automotive electronics manufacturers, industrial control device makers, and power management IC users. The company serves markets in automotive electronics, industrial automation, renewable energy, AI data centers, consumer electronics, and electric vehicles. It has established partnerships with leading global automotive component suppliers and targets high-growth segments such as electric vehicles and renewable energy systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in the Hsinchu Science Park. It serves a global customer base including clients from Europe, the Americas, China, Japan, and South Korea. The company actively pursues international market expansion and diversifies sales channels to mitigate geopolitical and supply chain risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a wafer foundry providing manufacturing services for power semiconductor devices. It collaborates closely with upstream IC design houses and downstream packaging and testing companies. It also integrates vertically within its corporate group to enhance supply chain efficiency and cost competitiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding automotive and industrial power semiconductor product lines, developing high-value-added and differentiated products, and advancing SiC and GaN compound semiconductor technologies. The company invests in R&D to improve device performance, reliability, and manufacturing efficiency, with a focus on trench MOSFETs, IGBTs, and customized analog ICs. It emphasizes ESG integration, cost control, and capacity expansion aligned with market demand.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through wafer foundry manufacturing services and product sales of power semiconductor devices. The company sells customized semiconductor wafers and finished power devices to automotive and industrial customers. It also earns income from licensing and long-term supply agreements with strategic partners. Revenue growth is driven by volume increases, product mix optimization, and price improvements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global IDM leaders such as Infineon, STMicroelectronics, Fuji Electric, and ROHM in the power semiconductor market. It faces increasing competition from Chinese manufacturers benefiting from domestic policies and cost advantages. The company positions itself as a specialized foundry with strong trench technology expertise and a focus on automotive and industrial niches, leveraging group synergies to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.89 billion (about US$58.27 million) in 2024, representing a 27.7% increase over the prior year. Operating profit turned positive with NT$45 million and net profit after tax reached NT$91 million, reflecting a strong recovery from previous losses. The company maintains a solid asset base of over NT$3.3 billion and equity of NT$2.44 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion supporting growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable power semiconductor devices tailored for automotive and industrial applications, with a strong focus on trench technology and customized solutions. It differentiates through advanced manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive product lines including SiC and GaN devices, and close collaboration with customers for specification compliance. The firm also highlights its ESG commitment, cost control, and integration within a corporate group to offer competitive pricing and supply chain resilience.
